question: Should the fix own both managed-gateway WhatsApp plugin readiness and the Windows inline recovery flow, or should the gateway/package defect be tracked upstream while this repository adds only capability-aware guidance?
rationale: The observed blocker crosses the Windows setup/UI boundary and the separately versioned gateway plugin system; repository inspection proves the failure but cannot establish which release pipeline failed to provide or activate the provider on the reporter's gateway.

options.title: Coordinate gateway and Windows recovery
options.body: Diagnose the pinned gateway installation, fix provider readiness where necessary, and add a consent-based Doctor/Fix path in the Channels page for managed and external gateways.

options.title: Windows guidance only
options.body: Leave gateway packaging unchanged and replace the raw exception with capability-aware install, enable, refresh, and diagnostic guidance.

options.title: Route upstream first
options.body: Confirm and fix a gateway packaging or activation regression before changing the Windows pairing experience.

recommendation.title: Coordinate gateway and Windows recovery
recommendation.body: Diagnose the pinned gateway installation, fix provider readiness where necessary, and add a consent-based Doctor/Fix path in the Channels page for managed and external gateways.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Windows release's pinned gateway version, setup pipeline, and recent Channels page integration rather than only the original UI implementation.
